name: MWNotif – Bootstrap Notification Alert
author: MW

sections.description:
MWNotif is a lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to display customizable Bootstrap notification alerts on your website. Perfect for announcements, warnings, or important information you want to share with your visitors.

Key Features

  • Easy Configuration: Simple admin interface to set up and manage your notification alerts
  • Customizable Appearance: Choose from predefined background and text colors (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Gray/Black)
  • Display Controls: Set how long notifications appear and when they reappear after being dismissed
  • Slideout Animation: Smooth slideout animation from the top of the page
  • Flag Icon Option: Option to show a flag icon after notification is closed for easy reopening
  • Session Management: Control whether notifications reappear after browser sessions end
  • User Role Access: Admin and Editor roles can manage notifications
  • Mobile-Friendly: Responsive design works on all devices

How It Works

  1. Configure your notification text and appearance in the admin area
  2. Set display duration and session validity options
  3. Activate the notification to display it on your website
  4. Visitors will see your notification slide in from the top of the page

Use Cases

  • Announce important news or updates
  • Display temporary maintenance notices
  • Highlight special offers or promotions
  • Show cookie consent notices
  • Alert visitors about important information

Looking for More Features?

Working on MWNotif PRO for additional features including:

  • Advanced styling options
  • Multiple notification types
  • Custom positioning
  • Advanced animation effects
  • And much more!

Additional Information

Languages

  • English

Credits

  • Uses Bootstrap for styling
  • Uses Bootstrap Icons for the flag icon
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mwnotif folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘MW Notification’ in your admin menu to configure settings
sections.faq:
Can I customize the colors beyond the predefined options?

The free version offers predefined color schemes (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Gray/Black). For more customization options, check out MWNotif PRO.

Will the notification appear on all pages?

Yes, the notification will appear on all pages of your website when activated.

Can I show different notifications on different pages?

The free version displays the same notification across your entire site. For page-specific notifications, consider upgrading to MWNotif PRO.

How do I make the notification disappear after a certain time?

In the MW Notification settings, set the “Display Duration” to the number of seconds you want the notification to appear before automatically hiding.

Will visitors see the notification every time they visit my site?

This depends on your “Session Validity” setting:
* If set to 0, the notification will only be hidden until the browser session ends
* If set to a number of hours, the notification will reappear after that time period has passed

Can I add links or formatting to my notification text?

Yes, you can use basic formatting options including bold, italic, underline, headings, lists, and links in your notification text.
